summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.87/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.87 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 4, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 7¢ higher than a week ago, 36¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.01 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.64) and the highest in Superior ($4.07).
